package.name: amr_core
package.description: Configuration and geometry foundation shared by every node in the AMR stack. Turns the robot-model and fleet YAML files into validated C++ structs (RobotProfile, DynamicLimits, SafetySpec, FleetConfig) so no node hard-codes a physical constant. Deliberately free of any rclcpp dependency so the algorithmic layers built on it stay unit-testable.
